title: FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions Rate Card
content:
FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions are sold in six grades. Each grade fixes the efficiency rating and nominal depth of the filter it ships, the number of filters in each shipment for each subscribed size, the number of months between shipments, and the price of one filter in a standard size.

| Grade | Efficiency rating | Nominal depth | Filters per shipment, per subscribed size | Months between shipments | Price per filter, standard size |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | MERV 8 | 1 inch | 2 | 6 | $12.99 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | MERV 11 | 1 inch | 2 | 6 | $18.99 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | MERV 13 | 1 inch | 2 | 4 | $26.99 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | MERV 11 | 4 inches | 1 | 6 | $44.99 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | MERV 13 | 4 inches | 1 | 6 | $54.99 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | MERV 16 | 5 inches | 1 | 6 | $69.99 |

### Which homes each grade is offered to

A grade is signed up only for a home whose system takes a filter of that grade's nominal depth. The three 1-inch grades (Standard MERV 8, Pleated MERV 11 and Allergen MERV 13) are for systems with no media cabinet installed; the three Media Cabinet grades are for systems with a media cabinet installed.

| Grade group | Media cabinet installed in the home's system | Filter depth the system must take |
|---|---|---|
| Standard MERV 8, Pleated MERV 11, Allergen MERV 13 | No | 1 inch |
| Media Cabinet MERV 11, Media Cabinet MERV 13 | Yes | 4 inches |
| Media Cabinet MERV 16 | Yes | 5 inches |

### Notes to the rate card

1. The price per filter is the price of one filter in a size on the grade's own standard size list.
2. Filters per shipment are counted for each subscribed size: a subscription for one size receives that number of filters of that size in every shipment.
3. Months between shipments are a whole number of months.

### Shipment cycles in a year (derived illustration)

For a subscription that ships every cycle without a skip or a pause, twelve months divided by the months between shipments gives the cycles in a year, and that figure multiplied by the filters per shipment gives the filters received in that year.

| Grade | Cycles in a year of uninterrupted shipments | Filters in that year, per subscribed size |
|---|---|---|
| Standard MERV 8, Pleated MERV 11 | 2 | 4 |
| Allergen MERV 13 | 3 | 6 |
| Media Cabinet MERV 11, 13 and 16 | 2 | 2 |
